name: Furnace (forced air)

combustion.note: Gas models: exhaust goes out by chimney or vent pipe; cracks or a vent blocked by snow put CO in the house (Health Canada CO). Blower, inducer and controls run on 115 V, so no heat in an outage. kW is gas input; W is max unit amps x 115 V, a ceiling (Bryant 800SA, 5.6-13.4 A).

comps.spec: Hot surface igniter (silicon carbide or nitride, glows at 120 V) or spark igniter on older units
comps.loc: In the burner area, next to the flame sensor
On the heat exchanger and burner box

notes: A gas furnace needs mains power for its blower, inducer and controls, so it stops in a power cut even with gas in the pipe (Bryant 800SA). Check gas appliances for cracks and blocked vents, and clear the outside vents of snow and ice after every storm: a blocked vent sends carbon monoxide into the house (Health Canada CO).
